title: The Angevins next shut the merchants of al-Andalus out of Flanders
source: Trent's account (8 January 1447); the autosave of 1 February 1447 dates it 7 January

title: Al-Andalus answers the Angevins in kind and closes its markets to their merchants, beside the embargo it has kept on them since 1440

Since 1442 the treasury has gone into the towns, each being made good at a trade: cannon foundries, gunsmiths, saltpetre works, tanneries, masons, glass and pottery, cloth workshops doubled at Qurṭuba and Ishbīliya, and twenty-seven bridges
source: Trent's account (12 November 2026); the buildings from the saves of 11 June 1442, 27 August 1444 and the autosave of 1 February 1447
